name: vantage-point
description: Vantage Point: a HUD above the Claude Code prompt, and the human queue, where agents queue asks and you rule yes/no with comments, from the desktop or your phone.

frontierScript.title: Frontier script
frontierScript.description: Path to agent-config's scripts/spec-frontier.mjs. Empty or missing: the frontier comes from this repo's issue labels.

readerGist.title: Reader gist
readerGist.description: Ask agents to end a long reply with a short gist, which the RSVP Reader plays first. Off: no instruction is added to the system prompt, and the Reader plays the full reply.
